description: macwin-core Engine: the controller state machine from design.md §5.9 (Local <-> Remote, epochs with dialer-odd/listener-even parity, Controlling/Controlled roles, TakeControl ownership switch, takeover by local input, pre-grab and held_from_remote key semantics, target injection rules, ModifierSync, latest-wins MouseAbs, heartbeat cadence/timeout/reconciliation, grab lease renewal, capture-fault handling, disconnect and shutdown releasing everything) with the 18 scenario tests and the random-interleaving property test. Plan item 10. Depends on FEAT-002.
steps: Create crates/macwin-core/src/engine/mod.rs with the public API exactly as design §5.9 (EngineConfig {local_os, local_screens, peer_side, remap, timings: Timings}, TransportRole {Dialer, Listener}, PeerInfo, LocalOutcome {deliver, actions}, Action {SendControl, SendInput, SendDatagram, Inject, Capture, RenewLease, Close}, CloseReason {HeartbeatTimeout, ProtocolViolation(&'static str), Shutdown, Internal(&'static str)}, Engine::{new, set_local_screens, on_connected, on_disconnected, on_local_event, on_control, on_input, on_datagram, on_tick, on_capture_fault, shutdown, role}) and the constants TICK, HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL, HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT, GRAB_LEASE, TAKEOVER_THRESHOLD, TAKEOVER_WINDOW (re-export EDGE_REENTRY_INSET from layout).

Create crates/macwin-core/src/engine/session.rs holding the per-connection Session (PeerInfo, Layout, Remap, parity, epoch_max, Role {Idle, Controlling{epoch, v, exit, npl_src, pre_grab, fwd_buttons}, Controlled{epoch, injected_keys, injected_buttons, last_pos, takeover_accum, last_phys_move}}, HeartbeatMonitor, outgoing datagram seq, target last_seq) and LocalInput (physical keys, buttons, last pos, held_from_remote). Implement every row of the §5.9 transition table, the local-event rules (repeat detection for Windows-style repeated downs, swallow rules, pre_grab up delivered AND forwarded), the target injection rules (repeat only if held, up only if held, Button -> MoveTo then button, ModifierSync release-then-press, clamp all peer positions), next_epoch parity, epoch_max updated only from Enter on the input stream, wrong-parity or epoch-0 Enter -> Close(ProtocolViolation), heartbeat reconciliation, `held_from_remote = physical - pre_grab` whenever Controlling ends, on_received for every valid peer frame, INFO logs for role transitions with no key identities.

Create crates/macwin-core/src/engine/tests.rs (`#[cfg(test)] mod tests;`) with the 18 scenario tests listed in design §5.9, each feeding a scripted sequence with synthetic Instants and asserting the exact Vec<Action>. Use shared builders (mac_1440x900(), win_1920x1080(npl), engine pairs) to keep tests short.

Add the proptest in engine/tests.rs: random interleavings of local CapturedEvents, peer Control/Input/Datagram messages (valid and stale epochs), ticks with random time advances (including > HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT gaps), capture faults, disconnect/reconnect and shutdown, on both TransportRoles. Check invariants (a)-(e) from §5.9 plus: after every Leave, on_disconnected, heartbeat timeout and shutdown, the Engine's injected keys/buttons (downs minus ups emitted as Inject) are zero per key and per button; while Idle no Key/Button/Wheel/MouseAbs is sent. Keep the default 256 cases and runtime under 60 s.
acceptance_criteria: `RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=stable cargo test -p macwin-core engine` passes: all 18 design §5.9 scenarios and the property test
Property test proves no key or button stays injected after Leave, disconnect, heartbeat timeout or shutdown for random sequences
Epochs emitted by a Dialer engine are odd and strictly increasing; by a Listener even and strictly increasing
Engine uses no clocks, threads or I/O (time only via Instant arguments); macwin-core still has #![forbid(unsafe_code)]
clippy -D warnings clean for macwin-core on host and x86_64-pc-windows-gnu
